title: Pig: push-your-luck dice game
description: Simplest push-your-luck dice game. Roll a d6: score the value, or roll a 1 and lose your turn score. Player chooses roll or bank each action. First to 100 wins. Validates: dice rolling (server authority), multi-action turns (roll/bank decision loop), counter-based scoring, simple end condition (score >= 100). Tiny definition, good starter dice game.
